# spx_storage_classes (Data Source)

Retrieves the list of StorageClasses available for a project and an AZ.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Storage classes available in the availability zone, sorted by name
data "spx_storage_classes" "all" {}

output "storage_classes" {
  value = data.spx_storage_classes.all.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) The list of StorageClass names.
